title: Major Food Recall Expands as Salmonella Outbreak Continues
subtitle: Taylor Farms pulls many products from store shelves as health officials track a dangerous bacterial infection.

summary.en: Taylor Farms has issued a wide recall of products containing jalapeño peppers. This action follows a large Salmonella outbreak linked to a supplier. At least 345 people across 27 states have become ill from the bacteria. Health officials are working to identify all affected food items. Consumers are advised to check their refrigerators for recalled items.
summary.zh: 泰勒農場已針對含有墨西哥辣椒的產品發布大規模召回。此舉是因應一起與供應商有關的大規模沙門氏菌疫情。全美二十七個州至少有三百四十五人因該細菌而生病。衛生官員正致力於確認所有受影響的食品項目。建議消費者檢查冰箱，確認是否有召回範圍內的產品。

paragraphs.en: A major food company, Taylor Farms, has announced a large recall of products containing jalapeño peppers. This decision comes after a serious Salmonella outbreak was linked to their supplier, Coast Citrus Distributors. Salmonella is a type of bacteria that causes food poisoning, leading to symptoms like fever, stomach pain, and diarrhea. This recall is a significant step in trying to stop the spread of the illness, which has already affected hundreds of people across the United States.
paragraphs.zh: 大型食品公司泰勒農場（Taylor Farms）宣布大規模召回含有墨西哥辣椒的產品。這項決定是在發現嚴重的沙門氏菌疫情與其供應商海岸柑橘經銷商（Coast Citrus Distributors）有關後所做出的。沙門氏菌是一種會導致食物中毒的細菌，會引發發燒、胃痛和腹瀉等症狀。此次召回是阻止疾病擴散的重要舉措，目前全美已有數百人受到影響。

paragraphs.en: According to Ars Technica, the recall includes a wide variety of items. These products range from simple diced jalapeños and salsas to pre-made salads, burritos, and sandwiches. The affected foods were sold in 26 states at many well-known retailers, including Walmart, Target, Kroger, Whole Foods, Trader Joe’s, and Hannaford. Because the products include both branded and unbranded items, health experts are urging shoppers to be very careful and check their kitchens for any items that might be part of the recall.
paragraphs.zh: 根據科技媒體 Ars Technica 報導，此次召回的品項非常廣泛，從簡單的墨西哥辣椒丁和莎莎醬，到預製沙拉、墨西哥捲餅和三明治皆包含在內。受影響的食品在全美二十六個州的許多知名零售商販售，包括沃爾瑪（Walmart）、塔吉特（Target）、克羅格（Kroger）、全食超市（Whole Foods）、缺德舅（Trader Joe’s）以及漢納福德（Hannaford）。由於這些產品包含自有品牌與無品牌商品，健康專家呼籲消費者務必提高警覺，檢查家中廚房是否有任何屬於召回範圍的物品。

paragraphs.en: The current situation is part of a larger, difficult summer for food safety in the United States. Health officials report that at least 345 people in 27 states have become sick due to the Salmonella bacteria. Of those people, at least 36 have been sent to the hospital for treatment. Fortunately, no deaths have been reported so far. The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) noted that the first illnesses were reported on June 19. Investigators spoke with 191 of the sick people, and 177 of them said they had eaten at Mexican-style restaurants, such as Chipotle and Qdoba, before they became ill.
paragraphs.zh: 目前的情況是美國今年夏天食品安全面臨嚴峻挑戰的一部分。衛生官員指出，全美二十七個州至少有三百四十五人因感染沙門氏菌而生病，其中至少三十六人住院治療。幸運的是，目前尚未傳出死亡案例。美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）表示，首批病例於六月十九日通報。調查人員訪談了一百九十一位患者，其中一百七十七人表示在發病前曾食用過墨西哥式餐廳的餐點，例如奇波雷（Chipotle）和 Qdoba。

paragraphs.en: In response to the health risks, major restaurant chains took quick action. Chipotle stopped using jalapeños from Coast Citrus on July 20, and Qdoba followed by stopping the use of the peppers on July 28. The FDA and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) identified Coast Citrus Distributors as the source of the contaminated peppers on August 5. The peppers were grown in Sinaloa, Mexico, and then sent to various food distributors and restaurants. The FDA stated that Coast Citrus is currently working to contact all of the companies that bought the peppers to ensure they are removed from the market.
paragraphs.zh: 針對這些健康風險，大型連鎖餐廳迅速採取行動。奇波雷於七月二十日停止使用海岸柑橘供應的墨西哥辣椒，Qdoba 隨後也於七月二十八日跟進。食品藥物管理局與疾病管制與預防中心（CDC）於八月五日確認海岸柑橘經銷商為受污染辣椒的源頭。這些辣椒是在墨西哥的錫那羅亞州種植，隨後分銷至各地的食品經銷商與餐廳。食品藥物管理局表示，海岸柑橘目前正積極聯繫所有購買該批辣椒的企業，以確保產品全數下架。

paragraphs.en: While this recall is a necessary safety measure, it has raised questions about how quickly companies react to such threats. Ars Technica reported that it is not yet clear why it took Taylor Farms several days to identify that their products contained the peppers from the supplier. The company has been asked when they first realized they were affected by the recall and if they were contacted directly by Coast Citrus, but they have not yet provided a response.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然此次召回是必要的安全措施，但也引發了外界對於企業應對此類威脅速度的質疑。Ars Technica 報導指出，目前尚不清楚為何泰勒農場花了數天時間才確認其產品含有該供應商的辣椒。該公司已被詢問何時意識到受到召回影響，以及是否曾直接收到海岸柑橘的聯繫，但目前尚未做出回應。

paragraphs.en: This Salmonella issue is happening at the same time as another major health concern. Taylor Farms is also dealing with a large outbreak of a parasite infection called Cyclospora, which has been linked to their iceberg lettuce. Cyclospora is a tiny organism that causes intestinal illness. These two outbreaks together have made this a record-breaking summer for foodborne illnesses in the country. Health experts believe that a combination of extreme heat and issues with fresh produce has led to these high rates of sickness.
paragraphs.zh: 此次沙門氏菌問題正值另一項重大健康疑慮發生之際。泰勒農場同時也在處理一場與其冰山萵苣有關的圓孢子蟲寄生蟲大規模感染疫情。圓孢子蟲是一種會導致腸道疾病的微小生物。這兩起疫情使得今年夏天成為美國食品傳染病發生率破紀錄的一年。健康專家認為，極端高溫與新鮮農產品的問題共同導致了這些高發病率。

paragraphs.en: For now, the best way for consumers to stay safe is to pay close attention to official recall notices. If you have purchased any of the products mentioned, it is best to throw them away or return them to the store. The FDA continues to monitor the situation closely as they work to track down the source of the contamination and prevent more people from getting sick. As the investigation continues, officials are reminding the public that washing produce and following food safety guidelines are important habits, especially during times when outbreaks are common.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，消費者保持安全最好的方式就是密切留意官方的召回公告。如果您購買了任何提及的產品，最好將其丟棄或退回商店。食品藥物管理局正持續密切監控情況，致力於追蹤污染源並防止更多人染病。隨著調查持續進行，官員提醒大眾，清洗農產品並遵守食品安全準則是非常重要的習慣，特別是在疫情頻發的時期。

keyTerms.definitionEn: An official order for products to be returned to the maker because of a defect or safety problem.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（回憶、收回），這裡作名詞用。文中：A major food company, Taylor Farms, has announced a large recall of products containing jalapeño peppers.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To include a variety of different things between two limits.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是常見的片語，表示種類的多樣性。文中：These products range from simple diced jalapeños and salsas to pre-made salads, burritos, and sandwiches.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To find someone or something after a difficult or long search.
keyTerms.noteZh: 由動詞與副詞組成的片語，意思與單純的 track 不同。文中：The FDA continues to monitor the situation closely as they work to track down the source of the contamination and prevent more people from getting sick.

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the specific timeline regarding the identification of the contamination source?

options.A: The FDA and CDC identified Coast Citrus Distributors as the source on July 20.
options.B: The first illnesses were reported on June 19, and the source was identified on August 5.
options.C: Chipotle stopped using the peppers on August 5, the same day the FDA identified the supplier.
options.D: The FDA identified the source of the contamination before Chipotle stopped using the peppers.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，第一批病例於 6 月 19 日回報；第四段明確指出 FDA 與 CDC 在 8 月 5 日才確認 Coast Citrus Distributors 為污染源。選項 A 錯誤，因為 7 月 20 日是 Chipotle 停止使用辣椒的日期，而非確認供應商的日期。選項 C 錯誤，因為 Chipotle 在 7 月 20 日就已停止使用，早於 8 月 5 日的官方確認。選項 D 錯誤，因為餐廳是在官方確認來源前就已採取行動。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the communication between Taylor Farms and their supplier, Coast Citrus Distributors?

options.A: Taylor Farms was informed by Coast Citrus immediately after the first illnesses were reported.
options.B: The supplier, Coast Citrus, likely failed to notify Taylor Farms promptly about the contaminated peppers.
options.C: Taylor Farms knew about the contamination but intentionally delayed the recall for several days.
options.D: There is no evidence of a business relationship between Taylor Farms and Coast Citrus Distributors.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第五段提到，Taylor Farms 花了數日才確認產品含有該供應商的辣椒，且公司對於是否收到供應商直接通知未作回應，這暗示了供應鏈溝通存在延遲或斷層。選項 A 與事實不符，因為若有立即通知，Taylor Farms 不會花數日才確認。選項 C 過度推論，文章僅提到「不清楚為何延遲」，未證實是故意隱瞞。選項 D 與第一段衝突，第一段已明確說明 Coast Citrus 為其供應商。

quiz.question: In the context of the last paragraph, what does the word 'monitor' mean?

options.A: To observe and check the progress or quality of something over a period of time.
options.B: To physically remove dangerous items from store shelves.
options.C: To create new safety laws to prevent future outbreaks.
options.D: To interview people who have become sick from food poisoning.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中提到 FDA 持續「monitor」情況，意指持續追蹤、觀察事態發展以確保安全。選項 B 是「recall」的定義，而非 monitor。選項 C 雖是政府職能，但文中並未提到 FDA 此刻正在制定新法。選項 D 屬於調查過程中的一個環節，但「monitor」本身涵蓋更廣泛的持續性觀察，而非僅限於訪談。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: To explain the biological symptoms caused by Salmonella and Cyclospora.
options.B: To criticize Chipotle and Qdoba for their slow response to the food safety crisis.
options.C: To describe the challenges of growing peppers in Sinaloa, Mexico.
options.D: To report on a significant food safety crisis involving recalls and widespread illness.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。本文主旨為報導美國近期發生的食品安全危機，包含 Taylor Farms 的大規模召回、Salmonella 與 Cyclospora 疫情，以及政府與企業的應對措施。選項 A 僅是文章的一部分細節，非主旨。選項 B 不正確，文章反而提到餐廳採取了快速行動。選項 C 僅提到產地，並非文章探討的核心議題。因此 D 最能概括全文重點。
